ABOUT_CONTENT: I have been a developer for over 11 years, with 8 years as a SAP ABAP consultant.
I work as a specialist in SAP S/4HANA solution architecture and integrations with legacy and cloud systems.
I have experience leading technical teams in S/4HANA implementation and migration projects.
Passionate about automation, performance and innovative solutions that add business value.
HISTORY_CONTENT: I started programming around age 15, creating macros to automate actions in online games. It was fascinating to see how a few lines of code could execute repetitive tasks more efficiently.
Then I started exploring .bat scripts and Windows automations, creating solutions that triggered specific actions from key combinations. This curiosity led me to discover the power of programming.

In 2014, I participated in a scientific research project on software agents at university, studying autonomous system behavior - long before the current generative AI revolution. That's where I learned about intelligent algorithms and decision-making systems.
This solid foundation in automation and intelligent systems became fundamental in my SAP career, where I apply these concepts to complex integrations and enterprise solutions.
